rationale: Abstract ⲙⲛⲧ- noun split across lines 2-3 of K.274. Element ⲁϣⲗⲣⲉ not securely identifiable. Three candidate analyses: (a) Lyc form on ϣⲗⲏⲗ 'pray' = 'prayer-state' (fits chapter's prayer theme); (b) related to ϣⲏⲣⲉ 'child' = 'sonship' (fitting the brothers/Five Sons); (c) privative ⲙⲛⲧ-ⲁⲧ-X. Context: 'the works of the X-hood which his brothers established, that came forth from the Height.' Flagged for parallels in subsequent kephalaia.

Lycopolitan with prosthetic/dialectal ⲉ- prefix on ⲁⲙⲛⲧⲉ 'Hades, underworld.' In K.274 line 8 designates the lower cosmological realm of death where the soul is bound — paired with ⲡⲥⲁⲙⲡⲓⲧⲛⲉ 'the lower side.' Direct cosmological-correspondential identification: the soul stands before this Hades to be released forth.

Qualitative modifier on ⲡⲓⲉⲙⲛⲧⲉ 'this Hades' (line 8). Etymology unclear. Possibilities: (a) related to ϣⲱϫⲉ 'burn, scorch'; (b) ϣⲱϫϩ̄ 'be afflicted'; (c) ϣⲱⲣϣⲣ̄ 'destruction' nominalized. The pairing with ⲧⲓⲙⲱⲣⲓⲁ 'punishment' and ⲑⲗⲓⲃⲉ 'oppression' (line 5) supports the harshness register. Confidence low.

Verb of unclear etymology (line 18). Context: 'he gave her wideness from oppression, he ⲡ̄ⲟⲇⲟ as foremost into the whole body.' Possible analyses: (a) Greek πρόοδος/προοδέω 'go-before, lead forth'; (b) Coptic ⲡⲱⲱⲇⲉ 'leap, pass'; (c) ⲡⲱⲧ 'run' extended; (d) Greek πηδάω 'leap.' The directionality ⲁⲡⲥⲱⲙⲁ ⲧⲏⲣϥ 'to the whole body' and intensifier ⲍⲓ ⲍⲟⲩⲓⲧ 'as foremost' fit a leading/conveying sense. Flagged for parallels.

proposed_english: purpose of heart (variant of ⲡⲱⲕ ⲛⲍⲏⲧ)
rationale: Apparent variant of the well-attested ⲡⲱⲕ ⲛⲍⲏⲧ 'purpose of heart' (in glossary) at K.274 line 16. The ⲛ̄ insertion may be a scribal slip or reflect ⲡⲱⲛⲕ 'scoop, draw out' compounded with ϩⲏⲧ — but consistency with the immediately preceding lines 12-13 (which use ⲡⲱⲕ ⲛ̄ϩⲏⲧ) favors reading as a variant of the standard idiom. Translated identically.
